changelog:
v2.14.1 - Update loop fixed

- Fixed the app closing by itself: it no longer downloads and installs an update on every launch. It now checks once per day and only offers the update, so a failed install can never kill the app again.
- Shape Illusion is now a real wallpaper: the service was missing from the manifest in 2.14.0, so the feature did nothing. It is registered now.
- Tools -> Shape Illusion still picks Heart, Pentagon or Oval.
